The cover includes bold, stylized title typography at the top (partially cut off), a large yellow speech bubble with red text on the left, and several characters in the foreground wearing orange/red outfits. There are also smaller inset panels or boxes with additional artwork and text. The art style is consistent with mid-20th-century American comics.
